description: Creates (or finds) a free Shortbread consent-banner site for a domain and returns the script tag to add before </head>, plus a claim URL the site owner uses to take over the dashboard. No account needed. Idempotent per domain. Pass the owner's email so the claim link is emailed to them.

owner.description: Site owner's email; Shortbread emails the claim link

via.description: Which tool is installing, e.g. claude-code, cursor, codex. Defaults to mcp

name: provision_site
title: Create a Shortbread site and get the install snippet
